<DOCSTRING>
Binds a secret key to a list of bytes, ensuring the key is always represented as bytes.

Args:
    secret_key (str | bytes | cabc.Iterable[str] | cabc.Iterable[bytes]): The secret key to be converted to bytes. If a string or bytes, it is directly converted. If an iterable, each element is converted to bytes.

Returns:
    list[bytes]: A list of bytes representing the secret key.
</DOCSTRING>
